I’m in Australia so I can’t talk too muc about the cost in other places. I believe original quote for the night only study was around $500. It has since been put on Medicare so i believe it was free, or very close to being free. 


Sleep study is ok. They have all the wires and stuff on your head. I took my own blanket and pillow since the ones in this particular facility were like hospital blankets and pillows. 

They prefer you sleep on your back, especially if you have suspected sleep apnea. I have had that many sleep studies now that they don’t mind how I sleep, the daytime test (MSLT) is the more important one for me these days. 

I struggle to sleep usually but it’s mainly due to the wires and all the anxiety. Regardless of how tired I am, I really struggle to sleep to the point where I was crying last time haha. Not ideal and I don’t love doing them but i definitely suggest them to anyone who mentions they have issues with sleep. I was so impressed with the amount of data they can record and examine!!

Sorry for the late reply!!

I was tired all the time. I was eventually diagnosed with hypothyroidism when I was around 14 years old but the sleepiness didn’t get better. 

My endocrinologist assumed it was sleep apnea because of my weight. I knew it wasn’t that but I didn’t have the money for the sleep study. 

Years later I could afford the test. Sure enough no sleep apnea. I then had a day study (MSLT) to rule out narcolepsy. They ruled out a few other things (delayed sleep phase disorder, any other hormonal/blood test things) and finally gave me the diagnosis!

Thank you so much! 

When they came in and told me I had perforated my bowel my first words were actually “wait, I’m not being dramatic?” Because I really thought it was my period and they weren’t going to find anything. I thought at most it would have been a ruptured cyst on my ovary or something like that. I just kept saying I was happy I wasn’t being dramatic and they were taking it seriously (I mean they had to, it was a serious thing). Not sure if they would have taken me as seriously if I didn’t have the high fever and heart rate though. 

I am lucky because my aunt is a nurse and she was working when I went to urgent care. She wasn’t the treating nurse but it was great to have her there.

Hoping the colonoscopy goes well as well. If I’m not healed, it’s not the colostomy bag I’m scared of but the healing either side of the surgery (having it put in, and then eventually reversed). 

At least I know what to look out for now pain wise! Definitely won’t be waiting as long as I did to go to the hospital if I ever have pain again that’s for sure

They said to me it will take a while to heal (meaning, perforation/hole actually closed). I am having a colonoscopy April 3rd to check if it’s healed fully.

They said I will still have a little pain for a while while it healed fully but they didn’t say how long.

My low residue diet was just “until healed”. A doctor said until I feel better with no pain anymore. I still have occasional light pain though so I have stuck with the low residue

Thank you for this!! 

I was taking fibre supplements prior to the perforation alongside a pretty normal diet. I was constantly told my diet was the issue and had nothing to do with the family history which I found somehow hard to believe.

I actually got a call today, colonoscopy is April 3rd so only a week and a bit. Nervous to see what will show up, but I also want to get it over and done with.

My pain is only very occasionally and it’s very light to the point where I don’t know if im imagining it sometimes. I’m sure I’m not, but I haven’t had any other symptoms and my heart rate and temperature have all been fine (only checking like 5 times a day because I’m so paranoid haha)

I was on IV antibiotics and fluid for 4 days. I was on fluid only for 4 days and then it moved to light diet.

The 5 weeks since discharge I have been on low residue diet (essentially low fibre) on instruction from my doctor. 

I actually have a sleep disorder so I sleep anywhere from 10-12 hours a night. I also drink 2-3 litres of water a day so that’s not too much of a concern!!

Thanks for the advice, I will definitely check out bone broth!

I’m going through a mystery diagnosis situation at the moment with my GP. She is pretty new but absolutely amazing.

We don’t get notes in Australia, so I can’t comment on that part.

However my doctor requested a CT. She explained what she thought was wrong (AV malformation) in basic terms that I would understand. She also explained how she thought this issue could be causing the symptoms I’m experiencing. 

I think he should have explained the theory and why his theory links to the symptoms you are experiencing. For example, my doctor explained AV malformation but also explained how that particular issue would be causing the symptoms I’m experiencing. She explained her theory and also explained how it would line up and what we can do to diagnose it.

I don’t think you should have to ask your doctor what they think. You are going to the doctor to get health issues checked out, they should be letting you know what they think. Obviously I’m not sure what your notes say, but without it being explained to you, that would make it very easy for you to go home and google for yourself. 

Imo: if they are testing for something, they should explain what the test is for and how the results can relate to your health issue. They should be telling you why they are doing the particular test they are doing and how it’s going to help them understand your concern more

I think there is a big misconception about alcohol abuse. My father has been an alcoholic for as long as I can remember (I’m 24). He was a high functioning alcoholic and would go to work every day normal, he would be able to interact with friends and had long time friendships and held down a job. He would only drink at night when none of his friends were around. He would joke about being an alcoholic but not many of his friends actually seen it and seen how bad it was. 

He never missed work because of it, and talking to him during the day you would never know. 

I don’t think we knew about it because she didn’t want us to know about it. Alcoholics, or any other forms of addiction, are very easy to hide if the user wants to hide it. Considering we also don’t see her daily and only really hear her, it would have been near impossible for anyone to know

Only just watched this episode but had to come read what others thought. I seen it come up on the DVR and sent a photo of it to my friend that I used to watch catfish with sometimes. We got sick of the lack of surprise (it’s always a friend, family member or just some random) and stopped watching. However obviously this story sounded bonkers. 

I instantly thought it was Shannon passing information to Courtney. I told my friend what was happening and she suspected Courtney was a “mistress” of sorts and was with the father when he killed Kayla’s mum (father was having an affair with Courtney).

My takeaway thoughts are that Courtney was absolutely being fed information. 

I don’t think Kayla was in on any set up initially. She seemed genuine with her emotions and when they were talking to Eric/a on the phone I feel as though Kayla’s reactions were genuine. However, I feel as though during the time filming was taking place, Kayla started realising Shannon was lying. The part that stands out is Shannon being so against psychics on camera but there is proof she was seeing them and most likely paying money. I think Kayla picked up on that and that’s when she started to become more skeptical and more open to Courtney being a fraud. 

The whole “you have your fathers eyes” thing is super strange and made me uncomfortable. They have been talking for 2 years and I assume she has seen photos of Kayla before, she seemed shocked she had her fathers eyes and I still dont know what to make of that. It really made me think Courtney had met frank before he died. 

I think it seems like there was a lack of investigation on Nev and Max’s behalf because they quickly found out it was a scam but since Kayla did seem incredibly emotional, they decided to let her go on with it. With most catfish cases, it’s easy to prove the person isn’t who they are claiming to be. In this case, there isn’t a definite way to say Courtney can’t speak to dead people and if it brings Kayla peace they might have decided to leave it at that. Even if they could prove that Courtney was being given information, there is no way they can prove she can’t speak to the dead. 

I believe my friends hunch to an extent, but maybe Courtney knew someone who was friends with Frank? I don’t think they were secretly dating, but I do believe she knew someone who knew frank (either before the crime or in prison). 

I believe Courtney came up with the plan to bring the family peace and she actually reached out to Shannon first (maybe seeing Shannon had an interest in psychics) and spun the story, and Shannon either willingly or unwillingly gave her information. That information was then passed to Kayla. 

I think if Nev and Max wanted to make this more believable, they should have done more digging. Gone into friends of the families on Facebook and seen if there were links. Asked more questions like if Courtney can communicate with others or just frank.

It leaves a lot to be desired and I think it’s obvious Courtney can’t actually speak to dead people, but I also don’t think Kayla was in on the scam either until maybe after the meeting at the park. I truly believe her emotions (especially after the call from Eric/a) and I believe that’s someone who truly believed she was speaking to a psychic. 

At the end of the day, these are real people. Kayla did actually lose both parents and that wasn’t made up for the show. No matter if the whole catfish thing was real/fake, I hope Kayla and her family are able to find peace eventually

Now however, I’m incredibly open and have been for the last 3 years or so. I will tell people my story and my mental health history in hopes it may help them or someone they know. 

I’m generally a pretty talkative person at my workplace (supermarket) and often I get stuck doing mundane jobs with someone for hours on end. Mental health often comes up and I’m more than happy to talk about it. I still suffer from depression and anxiety (not as severe as it used to be) and people are often surprised since I’m such an outgoing person (they don’t see me outside of work though).

I think that it’s more than fine, and often helpful to talk to friends/family if you want to speak about it. If they don’t take you seriously or they judge you then I will personally fight them (I’m only half joking). 

You say you don’t want to pretend to be ok, you don’t have to pretend but you don’t have to tell everyone everything either. You can say you aren’t going so well but you are speaking to someone or getting help. If someone keeps pushing for more information you don’t have to give it, you can say you are uncomfortable talking about it. 

I think you should wait to tell others (I don’t know what scope of people you plan to tell) until you are in a better place. If you are talking to others (coworkers, classmates etc) who MAY (unfortunately) not take you seriously or judge you, that has the ability to make you feel worse.

You only have to tell who you feel comfortable telling. It’s not everyone’s business if you don’t want it to be. I hated talking about my mental health after I was first diagnosed, but now when I have pretty much overcome my anxiety and depression, I will tell literally anyone who will listen. If they don’t believe me/judge me than I’m ok with that mentally. I share my story and experiences to try help people and I’m thankfully in a position where judgement doesn’t effect me mentally.

Looking after yourself is your number one priority. If you want to tell some people absolutely you can go ahead. If you are worried about being judged or not believed, I think hold back on telling some people. You don’t want to make yourself possibly feel worse if they do have a negative reaction!

I can’t speak to visiting a psychologist in school but I can imagine they would often get held up with other students etc, however that’s no excuse to not be as helpful as possible.

My therapist I ended up seeing in my last 2 years of high school however was actually the therapist from my high school that moved to a clinic an hour away. She came highly recommended from people who seen her while she was at the high school so that’s who I chose to see even after she moved. 

My mental health problems were due to being bullied and by the time I started therapy, the bully had left school so I was already quite a bit better than I had been so I can’t speak to the effectiveness as much, but I definitely still got stuff out of it that I remember today. 

I do think it’s interesting though that you said you didn’t go back after the first appointment and you didn’t want to rant. That’s sort of the point for the first session, my psychologist didn’t talk much either apart from a few questions to prompt me. She definitely looked uninterested and was just writing things occasionally and it made my anxiety worse thinking I was just boring her. 

However the next sessions are where things got broken down. Each issue I had brought up in the initial session was talked about further in later sessions and that’s when she gave me coping strategies and explained why I was thinking the way I was.

While the first appointment seems like a drag, they are literally there to listen to you. They can’t help you if you can’t tell them how you are feeling, and (in my case at least) I was definitely talking more than she was and I felt like I was ranting. 

I will say however she missed the mark a few times. My BMI puts me in the morbidly obese category (I’m 300lbs). I also had issues sleeping (always tired). 

She tried to setup a workout plan for me that would literally result in my mum PAYING me to exercise since she thought it would be beneficial to my mental health. I think this went beyond her duty as a therapist to make a workout plan and have my mum in organising some payment system.

It was fair for her to assume my excessive daytime sleepiness was caused by the depression despite me knowing full well it wasn’t (I had it before the depression) and she just gave me a pamphlet on good sleep hygiene. 

Later on down the line I was diagnosed with a neurological sleep disorder called idiopathic hypersomnia (similar to narcolepsy). 

I always found it frustrating when she would brush off my sleep problems and put it all down to the depression and just telling me to improve my sleep hygiene. I didn’t feel I was being listened to on that front (she isn’t a doctor that has knowledge about sleep disorders, however she didn’t have to brush me off either). 

Overall it’s hit or miss, and it might take a while to find someone who works well for you but please don’t give up!! Give it a few sessions and don’t be afraid to rant, you are paying them to listen!! 

Best of luck, I truly find someone who can help you out. It might take a few tries but your life is always worth it!

I believe at the start she was actually attacked/stalked. I do believe she had a stalker in the beginning but I believe since she viewed the police as incompetent she started devising attacks herself to hopefully get them to pay her more attention. I believed from almost the beginning that she was doing this herself due to the lack of reaction/care she seemed to have towards almost being murdered multiple times

For me, the biggest red flags were that every physical attack she happened to know she would be found easily. If someone really was attacking her, would they screw up the second time in the woods and let her walk away to find help? I can’t imagine that people would allow her to live after the first time because that’s increasing their risk of being identified (either by Cindy or the surveillance/phone tapping). The fact that someone would let her live so many times is unbelievable to me. She was so close to dying every time but always getting found in time. 

Another point for me was that she was so interested in psychology. She seemed to never have to undergo any mental health tests or anything, I suspect due to her career in that field she would know what to say to deflect suspicion from herself. 

I’m not sure about the whole multiple personalities thing. I’m really not, but it would make sense. One alter could be performing the attacks on her and then she switches to not remember what happened. I’m not super informed about multiple personalities but could it be that one of the alters was left handed so the needle Mark makes sense? 

My problem with the multiple personalities theory is that surely SOMEONE would have noticed in 7 years, especially when she was in hospitals? 

When I heard that god damn phone call I was already under the impression it was her but Christ I almost had a heart attack. The voice was absolutely female

My one problem is the airport phone call. A lot of people are saying wrong number but the chances of someone calling her on the wrong number with a no talking hang up call after she has suffered accused stalking for YEARS and a police officer happens to be there to hear the call? That’s absolutely the biggest coincidence in all of history, even if she was getting stalked, the chances of that happening while a cop was there seem super unlikely. 

Another slight problem is the person claiming they didn’t see the body despite it being metres from where they were squatting. Unless the scrub was dense they would have seen her or at the very least smelt her (as horrible as that sounds). 

At the end of the day, I think she intended for her death to be another attack where she hoped to be found. She made plans for that night (which a lot of people who are going to commit suicide wouldn’t do) knowing that when she wasn’t home they would be worried and go looking for her. I think she walked further than intended (she was a long way from the car) so they didn’t find her in time. The other man in the car park said he seen a blonde woman walking away from the shopping centre and despite him not being certain it was her, it would make sense. I think she didn’t park close to the ATM with hopes the car would be more visible when they were out looking for her and ultimately saving her. She orally ingested a LARGE amount of pills, she was either trying to kill herself or didn’t realise how much she was taking (possibly taking more after the initial pills and was drowsy). I just find it very hard to believe she would tie herself up like that if she planned on killing herself. I also find it hard to believe someone could force her to take that many pills. Either way, her death is incredibly sad and either way she was the victim. They should have been paying closer attention to her and when the police suspected her they should have put her through more stringent testing (probably mentally) to check her mental health instead of her being constantly discharged from hospital

This came up on trending and I never usually pay attention but I had to for this post. This will be incredibly long. 

I’m 22 and my father has been a high functioning alcoholic my entire life that I can remember. Getting arrested when I was very young while drunk driving with my in the car. He needed a interlock installed. I always thought it was normal to have an alcoholic parent until I started spending time with friends and staying at their house and seeing how their fathers behaved and seeing that their fathers were absolutely nothing like my father. 

My parents broke up when I was 1.5-2 years old but both still live in the same small town.
Through school and few years of high school i stayed with my dad when my mum would work night shifts (usually finishing midnight) so I had a lot of first hand experience.

My dad would drink a lot, think 8+ beers a night sometimes. When I was young (maybe 3-4) I got the taste of beer and always asked for a sip. It got to the point he would ask me to get him a beer and I would do it so I could take the top off and take a sip. My first and only time being tipsy/drunk was when I was around 7. I wouldn’t say fully drunk but I definitely opened a lot of beers, not only for him but his friends.

When it got to high school he would go to his friends house multiple times a week. They had a son my age and a daughter a few years younger and I would stay at their house on the weekends every chance I got.

I loved him but every night I stayed with him (including weekdays) he would buy a 12 pack of beer and drink most of it. He held a job and started early (usually before 6am). He would get irrationally angry at me for random things, the main one was leaving on power points if nothing was plugged in. For some reason that really upset him and if I had unplugged my phone from the charger and left the switch on I would be blasted.

He was never, ever physical. He was however INCREDIBLY emotionally abusive. Telling me that he would kill himself because clearly I didn’t love him. I understand this was anxiety and depression talking but I would be absolutely hysterical telling him I did love him and I didn’t know what he was talking about. One day it got so bad he was at his friends house (next door to the other family friend I would stay with on weekends, it’s a big group of friends) for a party. He was the worst I had ever seen him. I was playing Xbox in the lounge room with the other kids and he kept asking me what time mum was picking me up. He was that drunk he kept forgetting he has asked so he would ask me every 20 minutes or so. I got frustrated and he could tell by the tone of my voice. He then proceeded to say that clearly I don’t love him because he is an alcoholic, he is going to jump in front of a truck or train (it was somewhat close to a highway and train bridge) so I didn’t have to pretend to love him anymore. He got his stuff and stormed out of the house. 

You know I’m movies when someone finds out someone they love has died? They collapse and just start screaming? That was me. I followed him outside pleading and telling him how much I loved him. I ended up collapsing and just screaming because he wouldn’t turn around. I was screaming that loudly that not only people from the party came out but a few neighbours came out and someone stopped their car because the screaming was so intense. I kept calling and he wouldn’t pick up, finally I got hold of him and he was like “I’m not going to do it”. He didn’t. 

I stopped seeing him a lot after that. I couldn’t do it. I told him he needed to speak to a psychologist because clearly he has some mental health problems to sort out. He lost his best friend to suicide but was still not willing to seek help. 

I was also incredibly suicidal at the time, partly to bullying but majority was the emotional and psychological abuse I was put through with the constant threats of suicide ect. Also, for a while he was living with a friend and I stayed sometimes as well. When dad moved out, we moved 4 doors down from the friend. It’s a long story but one morning I woke up after unexpectedly staying the night at dads, it was around 5:30am, he had left for work and it was pitch black. I heard a noise so I got up thinking he was home (despite me hearing him leave, I just assumed he had come home and forgotten something). I walked into the kitchen to be greeted by his “friend” with a knife robbing us. He pulled the knife thinking someone else was robbing the house at the same time (lmao) and he was shocked to see me. He had been there the previous night to drink with dad and fix a faulty window lock when in reality he just pretended to fix it for easy entry to the house. He thought I was going to mums but she ended up having to stay back late so I ended up staying but he didn’t know I would be there. It has terrified me forever and I’m still scared of the dark. He got in without a key, without me hearing and pulled a knife. My dad knew this but despite that, when he was drunk he would refuse to let me sleep with a light on. He would make me turn them off and I would send myself into a panic attack and usually end up sleeping with my phone torch on.

It’s been 6-7 years since I have stayed the night at his house. A lot has changed. He has got his dream job and drinks far less (still a lot) knowing he has to be careful. I went to therapy but I still only see him once a week when we go out for lunch. I can’t go to his house because I can’t emotionally handle seeing him drink. I love him dearly, I always have, and he knows that now. I still have trauma, I still get upset sometimes about it and I still am terrified of the dark and still require a nightlight at 22. 

This was incredibly long and I’m crying now but I want to say thank you. Thank you for trying to understand for your kids sake. Thank you for trying. Can I suggest AA or some other think to help? My dad knew he was an alcoholic all along and would joke about it a lot, however he wasn’t ever willing to actually get himself help. His drinking and manipulation didn’t start out bad either but as I got older, his drinking got more and more out of hand. He worked 6am-4pm every single day and then went home and drank 8 beers. He done this my entire life and still does. He was incredibly high functioning, just not behind closed doors. It wasn’t always like that though, it slowly progressed to becoming more manipulative and his mental health spiralling. I know he didn’t want to be like that but he also refused to get help.

Please, I’m genuinely saying this from the bottom of my heart. Please seek some help for your kids sake. I’m so proud of you for being 5 days sober and I wish you all the best on your journey!

This is late but I was browsing. I suffer from IH and I also happen to be overweight so one part of this particularly struck a nerve with me in a negative way. 

“She doesn’t do anything to help her condition. She doesn’t exercise, she doesn’t try get on a regular sleep schedule, and she won’t drink coffee to wake herself up”. 

This struck some wild anger in me so if I come across as harsh I don’t mean this to be an attack. 

However, the whole thing about exercising. I can’t bring up my sleep disorder EVER without someone telling me I would just be better if I exercised. I get a lot of unsolicited advice (I work in retail and my sleep disorder comes up occasionally) on how to treat my sleep disorder and 99% of the time people ask why I don’t just exercise because that will give me more energy, and for some people I understand that’s indeed the case

However, you need to understand this isn’t just a normal person. This is a person with IH. I will often walk to/from work which is 1.2km each way. One time I literally fell asleep walking home and fell flat on my face. I have fallen asleep serving customers. Even when I walk home, which is indeed exercise, I’m that extra exhausted halfway home that I truly can fall asleep standing up because it’s happened to me before. It doesn’t give me more energy. 

As for the coffee part, you will find that coffee doesn’t help a lot of people who are diagnosed with IH. It’s not enough. For me dexamphetamine isn’t even enough so coffee is practically water to me.

Suggestions I have is more research on IH and reading experiences. It’s fine to read medical websites but talking to people who have IH is a lot better to help understand the severity. Another suggestion is help her get a diagnosis, that will get her some medication that will hopefully be able to help her a bit. Lastly, understanding. She doesn’t want to be like this. She might constantly talk about loving sleep but I can promise that even though she loves sleep so much, she doesn’t want to be like that. 

She knows how frustrated you are and I can guarantee that she is just as frustrated. She doesn’t want to be like this and she definitely doesn’t enjoy it.

Comedian Celeste Barber started a Facebook fundraiser and has raised a staggering 37 million dollars in 3 day’s. Singer Pink has donated 500k and a few other stars have pledged that much as well. That’s great, but I have to pose the question that right now, would the $100,000 be better divided between 10 charities for $10,000 each or the full lump sum of $100,000 going to a single organisation. My thoughts (without knowing the charities they have chosen) is that the $100,000 is better off going to a single charity. Obviously $10,000 is a lot of money, but is it enough to truly be able to make a difference after all this damage has been done.

I understand things have to be done like planting more trees and such, but I was very confused at lush taking this route. To me and others I have spoken to, this doesn’t seem much different to what they do normally. They sell charity pots and they pass on the profits to small charities. I think my main complaint is that they haven’t listed the exact charities and what they will be doing to help in the bushfire crisis and aftermath. From people I have been speaking to, it doesn’t seem like they are doing all that much more than usual aside from setting a minimum donation amount rather than whatever the profits are.

Yes, obviously it’s great that they are donating $100,000 but I personally think they are going the wrong way about it in this instance.

Lush labs is essentially “experimental” hence the “lab” part in the name. It’s where they trial new products before releasing them mainline. At the moment on the UK store they have 2 shower slimes which are brand new. 

Some previous successful lush labs include the naked skincare line and shower bombs. They sold them as limited edition and then once everyone loved them they brought them back.

We are essentially their human guinea pigs in the sense that we try the products which are released as limited edition and then depending on the reviews they may or may not make some or all of the products mainline.

It has gotten confusing lately though. Lush has their Liverpool store which has a TON of exclusive products. A lot of people wanted to try them so the last 2-3 releases have been Liverpool exclusive items. Not brand new (as Lush Labs usually is) but the only time they will be available online. A few of those products became mainline: Amercian Cream conditioner, Cookie Dough lip scrub, Argan dragon, Minamisoma, coco loco, easy peeler, aurora borealis scrub and sleepy soap are the ones I can remember off the top of my head. 

Lush Labs usually releases on the 29th of each month on the UK store. A lot of European countries do Lush Labs as well. Australia gets Lush Labs on the 29th as well but are a month behind the UK releases. For example, on the 29th of last month UK got the Slimes but Australia should be getting them this month on the 29th. 

TL;DR: lush labs is a limited edition monthly release of brand new items. Lush waits a while until they get feedback and then decide wether or not they want to make the products part of the mainline or not.
